content: include_dir crate (fabro fork_ask_docs.rs, 2026-09-22): Dir::files() lists only the IMMEDIATE directory — nested corpora need an explicit dir.dirs() recursion; Dir::get_file(rel_path) IS slash-path recursive and safe against traversal by construction; include_dir!(/../../../docs/x) prefix escapes the crate dir for repo-root assets; embed only the curated roots (docs/public at 43M dwarfed everything).

content: A replaced OpenAPI schema (with_replacement) needs three touch points; missing any fails downstream tests with E0432 while build.rs stays silent: (1) the schema + property refs in docs/public/api-reference/fabro-api.yaml, (2) the with_replacement entry in lib/foundation/fabro-api/build.rs, (3) the hand-maintained pub use fabro_types::... re-export list inside fabro-api/src/lib.rs's types module (fabro-3488 pass: only (3) made fabro_api::types::ServerSeedsSettings resolve). Corollary: a stale clippy fingerprint can replay an already-fixed E0432 after cargo check passes on the same tree — touch the crate's lib.rs to force a rebuild before re-diagnosing.

description: rustfmt joins backslash-newline continuations INSIDE format! literals into one line but KEEPS the indented whitespace as literal spaces (observed fabro sprint 19: a 21-space run inside a user-facing 422 detail; fmt and clippy cannot see inside literals). User-facing message literals inside format! are written as ONE line or assembled outside format!. Reviewer corollary: verify RENDERED bytes with a tiny print/rustc check, not source literals.
resolution: single-line message literals; render-verify in review

description: Cross-language string editing silently mangles Rust line continuations
resolution: Fixed in the fabro-900e review round: rewrote the two diagnostics in context_append_keys_within_allow.rs with real backslash-newline continuations and exact-equality assertions in the rule test (commit dc5959a80).

description: fabro-tool clippy gate red: nightly clippy denies map_unwrap_or and format_push_string; use map_or_else and write! into the String (std::fmt::Write) instead of push_str(&format!(..)) — seen in create.rs partial-success fix, run 01M1S6VRWQMD56M1X8HWAXDSNN
resolution: rewrote both sites; clippy -D warnings and all 67 fabro-tool tests green

content: User-facing fabro validate messages must be built as single-line format! strings (multi-line only via backslash-newline continuations verified by compilation), and the rule test must assert the EXACT expected message text, not substring containment. Substring assertions let mangled literals (embedded whitespace runs from scripted edits) pass review and ship garbled CLI output.

name: fabro host-hook transport (petri LocalHooks + worker env)
description: Host hooks run via petri LocalHooks; env_vars() exports FABRO_EVENT/RUN_ID/WORKFLOW/NODE_ID and sh -c .envs() ADDS to the inherited env, so a host hook inherits the WORKER process env - which the server controls via env_clear()+WORKER_ENV_ALLOWLIST (fabro-server/src/spawn_env.rs). cwd is set only when shares_host_filesystem(), false for the Docker provider. Hook script files never enter the workflow-version closure: fabro-manifest workflow_bundler.rs collects DOT references plus config-referenced files in collect_config_files, not run.hooks script paths. Fix path: collect via collect_bundled_file, stage host-side per run, pass a run-scoped env var (fabro-091b).
